title: GUI Store Management - Rework 1
outcome_summary: All nine work packages were delivered in a single cycle with zero regressions and zero rework iterations, closing every deferred and out-of-scope item tracked from the parent gui-store-management project. Fixes span WCAG 2.1 modal focus restoration, mode-aware UI hints, reorder error display, backend Git helper cleanup, a concurrency coalescing guard for reloadStoreContext(), and three new test cases — raising the suite from 3,944 to 3,947 passing tests. Project and manifest documentation were updated and .context/ snapshots regenerated.
project_summary: This rework addresses nine items carried forward from the gui-store-management synthesis: five deferred items and four out-of-scope observations. The fixes improve accessibility, reliability, test coverage, and code quality of the Stores tab in the MCP Server GUI.
